name: dsh-vscode
description: Run the DeepSeek Harness web GUI inside VS Code. Desktop VS Code only; local extension host only (Remote / vscode.dev unsupported).

dsh.binPath.description: Path to dsh's bin.js (e.g. .../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js) or to a folder containing it. Empty = auto-detect dsh on PATH.

dsh.openIn.description: Where to open the DSH GUI. 'browser' uses your system default browser.

dsh.allowNpxFallback.description: Bootstrap dsh via npx when no local install is found. Requires network access; errors distinguish 'dsh not found' from 'network failure'.

dsh.autoStart.description: Start the DSH server when VS Code starts.

dsh.autoWorkspace.description: Automatically register the VS Code workspace folder(s) as DSH workspaces when the panel opens, so the GUI auto-selects them instead of asking for a directory.

dsh.extraArgs.description: Extra dsh CLI arguments. Safety-relevant flags (--host, --port, --trusted-host) are rejected.

dsh.pinnedVersion.description: dsh version used by the npx fallback.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && node --test dist-test/
scripts.test:smoke: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && node test/smoke-runner.js
